prompt: Literature survey of visual anomaly detection for manufacturing defects. Explain from scratch; assume basic deep learning only. Knows DINO and CLIP. Core question: how do you find defects when you have almost no defect images? Benchmark first (MVTec AD, VisA), then families as deltas: feature embedding (SPADE, PaDiM, PatchCore), flows (FastFlow), synthetic anomalies (CutPaste, DRAEM), student-teacher (EfficientAD), unified (UniAD), zero/few-shot VLM (WinCLIP, AnomalyCLIP). Show scores, image vs pixel AUROC, speed vs accuracy on an edge GPU.
